key_insight: A guide-grounded multimodal LLM, combined with CNN and Grad-CAM outputs, produces ECG explanations that are more clinically consistent and less prone to hallucination.
clinical_relevance: This could improve trust and reproducibility in AI-assisted cardiac diagnosis by making generated ECG reports better aligned with established diagnostic criteria.
method: CNN and Grad-CAM extract class probabilities and lead-specific heatmaps from 12-lead ECG images.
A distilled ECG Interpretation Guide from textbooks and guidelines is injected as fixed knowledge for every case.
A multimodal LLM uses the ECG image, heatmap overlay, fact pack, and guide to generate structured reports.
evidence_signal: On the full PTB-XL test set, the method improved average BERTScore for impressions from 0.818 to 0.953 versus a strong baseline, while maintaining competitive classification performance.
watch_item: The approach depends on the quality and maintenance of the curated guide, and real-world deployment will need careful validation for robustness across sites and ECG populations.
paper_title: Enhancing Explainable Cardiac Diagnosis with Guide-Grounded Multimodal LLMs
